purpose: Shop editorial imagery, not photographs bound to a catalog SKU
method: Existing JPEG assets converted to WebP; no crop or generative changes. Assets with a grade field were then colour-corrected as it records.

assets.grade: Neutral daylight grade to match the walkthrough photographs: per-channel gains in linear light move the brightest 20% of pixels to sRGB (236, 234, 233), with a soft shoulder above 0.85 linear; shadows lifted with luminance gamma 0.8 and colour reduced to 90%. No crop or generative change.
